pemmican:moddesc: Smoke meat into jerky, grind it to powder, and render it with fat into long-lasting pemmican.
smokerack-empty: Rack empty. Right-click with meat to hang a piece; empty-handed to take the rack back.
smokerack-needfire: Light the fire to keep smoking.
smokingfirepit-unlit: Unlit. Light it with a torch or firestarter.
smokingfirepit-firepitbusy: Empty the firepit before adding a smoking rack.
guide-pemmican-text:
Pemmican & jerky
Trail food that keeps for months.

Preserving meat takes three steps: smoke it into jerky, grind the jerky into powder, then cook the powder with fat into pemmican.

1. Smoke meat into jerky
Craft a smoking rack from 3 sticks, a rope and a knife, then right-click an empty firepit with it to fit the rack over the fire. Feed it firewood (one log per click), light it with a torch or firestarter, and right-click with raw red meat, bushmeat, fish or poultry to hang up to 8 pieces. It smokes low and slow, so each log lasts a good while — keep it lit and, after about a day of smoking, every piece turns to jerky. Empty-handed, take pieces off one at a time; once the rack is empty, an empty-handed right-click pops it back off and leaves a plain firepit. Jerky keeps for months — far longer than fresh or cooked meat — and can be eaten as-is or added to stews.

2. Grind jerky into powder
Grind jerky in a quern, or crush it in the crafting grid with any loose stone. Each meat keeps its own nutrition, so red meat jerky yields red meat jerky powder, and so on.

3. Cook pemmican
In a cooking pot over a firepit, combine 1 rendered fat with 1 to 3 jerky powder to make pemmican — a dense, portable protein meal. Add a measure of salt to make salted pemmican, which keeps roughly twice as long. Serve it into bowls, or seal it in a crock to preserve it even further.
block-handbooktext-smokerack: Right-click an empty firepit with this to fit it on, turning the firepit into a smoking rack you can hang up to 8 pieces of meat on. Empty the rack and right-click it empty-handed to take it back. See the Pemmican guide.
block-handbooktext-smokingfirepit-*: A firepit with a smoking rack fitted over it. Feed it firewood, light it, and hang up to 8 pieces of meat to slow-smoke them into jerky. Empty the rack and right-click empty-handed to take the rack back, leaving a plain firepit. See the Pemmican guide.
item-handbooktext-jerky-*: Smoked, dried meat that keeps for months. Eat it as-is, add it to stews, or grind it into jerky powder for making pemmican. See the Pemmican guide.
item-handbooktext-jerkypowder-*: Ground jerky that keeps the nutrition of its source meat. Cook it with rendered fat in a pot to make pemmican. See the Pemmican guide.
